svg.title: How Justless works
svg.desc: How Justless works: 12 supported coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI, OpenCode, Windsurf, Cline, Roo Code, Kiro CLI, and Kilo Code) connect via hooks, MCP, or CLI to the local offline justless binary, which compacts commands (tests, lint, BuildKit, K8s/Cloud, CSV, diffs, JSON), code (26 graph langs, 48+ outline formats, map --html/--explain, lookup --graph, AST rename), and history (duplicates, semantic cues, multi-provider cache-safe --compact-live proxy with prefix-drift detection). Full output is archived locally in .justless/ (runs/, index.bin, observations/) and replayable byte-for-byte on demand via log, expand, and recall.
